title: Sign in and reach the dashboard
description: This test verifies that a user can log in with email and password and land on the main dashboard with analytics overview visible.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the dashboard overview is displayed
Verify key account metrics are displayed

title: Connect a supported app from the marketplace
description: This test verifies that a user can start connecting a supported platform from the apps marketplace and see it marked as connected.

steps.description: Select a supported platform to connect
Verify the platform is marked as connected
Verify connection status information is displayed

title: Create an account and reach the dashboard
description: This test verifies that a user can sign up with email and password and land on the main dashboard with analytics overview visible.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the dashboard overview is displayed
Verify key account metrics are displayed

title: View dashboard analytics and switch platform filters
description: This test verifies that a user can review the dashboard overview, filter metrics by platform, and see the display update.

steps.description: Verify key performance metrics are displayed
Verify the trend chart remains displayed

title: Open the analytics hub from the dashboard
description: This test verifies that a user can move from the dashboard into the analytics hub and see cross-platform comparison metrics.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to the analytics hub
Verify cross-platform comparison metrics are displayed

title: View cross-platform analytics overview
description: This verifies that a user can open the analytics hub and see the overall cross-platform performance summary needed to evaluate their account at a glance.

steps.description: Verify cross-platform summary cards are displayed

title: Generate a content draft from a topic prompt
description: This verifies that a user can enter a topic, generate a draft, and see platform-specific content suggestions appear.

steps.description: Fill in the topic prompt with a content idea about career growth
Verify a generated draft is displayed
Verify platform-specific formatting suggestions are displayed

title: Open a platform analytics view
description: This verifies that a user can drill down from the analytics hub into a specific platform view and see platform-specific analytics.

title: Adjust the dashboard date range
description: This test verifies that a user can change the dashboard date range and see the analytics overview update.

steps.description: Verify the trend chart remains displayed

title: Switch between planner calendar views
description: This verifies that a user can move between month, week, and list views and keep the planner usable in each mode.

steps.description: Switch back to the month view
Verify planner content is displayed in the current view

title: Change analytics time range and see updated metrics
description: This verifies that a user can adjust the analytics time range and review metrics for the selected period.

steps.description: Verify updated metrics are displayed for the selected time range

title: Reschedule a planner item to a new date
description: This verifies that a user can move a scheduled item to another date and see the updated schedule reflected.

steps.description: Assign a valid date to the item
Move the item to a different date
Verify the updated date is reflected in the planner

title: Save an edited content draft
description: This verifies that a user can generate a draft, edit the content, and save the updated draft successfully.

steps.description: Fill in the topic prompt with a content idea about personal branding
Edit the draft content with an updated version of the post
Verify the updated draft is saved
Verify the saved draft remains available

title: Update profile information and save it
description: This verifies that a user can edit profile details in settings and see the saved account information reflected on the page.

steps.description: Verify the updated account information is displayed

title: Review and filter growth recommendations
description: This verifies that a user can open recommendations, apply a category filter, and see the list narrow to relevant items.

steps.description: Verify the results are narrowed by the selected category

title: Review connected platforms and disconnect one
description: This verifies that a user can remove a connected integration from settings and see it no longer listed as connected.

steps.description: Verify the platform is removed from connected integrations

title: Create a planned item from the planner
description: This verifies that a user can create a new scheduled item from the planner and see it appear on the board.

steps.description: Select a date in the planner
Assign a valid date to the item
Verify the new planned item is displayed
Verify the item appears on the planning board

steps.description: Fill in the topic prompt with a content idea about product updates

steps.description: Verify platform-specific account information is displayed

Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Open the recommendations view from analytics

title: Show an error for invalid login credentials
description: This test verifies that entering incorrect email or password shows an authentication error and keeps the user on the auth page.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with invalid@example.com
Fill in the password field with wrong-password
Verify an authentication error message is visible
Verify the dashboard is not displayed

title: Prevent reconnecting an already connected platform

Verify the connection status remains unchanged
Verify the platform stays marked as connected

title: Show validation when required auth fields are empty

steps.description: Verify an inline validation message is visible
Verify the dashboard is not displayed

title: Show a validation message when generating without a prompt
